# ECN-2026-018 - Change notice - Machining radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-RR01

## Reason for change
Field inspection and review of maintenance records for EQ-P2-L3-RR01 identified inconsistent clamping preload on the mandrel assembly. Variability in clamp bolt preload has been correlated with mandrel slippage during finishing passes. To standardize assembly practice and reduce rework, the mandrel clamp bolt torque specification is being updated and the machining work instruction clarified.

Related documents: MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1, SOP-P2-L3-01, SOP-P2-L3-05

## Affected items
- Assembly and maintenance procedure for the mandrel clamp on EQ-P2-L3-RR01.
- MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1 — update reference torque and torque verification step.
- SOP-P2-L3-01 and SOP-P2-L3-05 — cross-reference and alignment with revised torque requirement.

Mandrel clamp bolt torque for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) is 470 N·m.

## Implementation
- Update MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1 to replace the current clamp torque instruction with the mandated value: 470 N·m. Include a torque verification step that references SOP-P2-L3-01 for measurement method and SOP-P2-L3-05 for recordkeeping.
- Retrain affected personnel on the revised step in MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1. Training records will reference EQ-P2-L3-RR01 and the updated procedures.
- Apply the revised torque requirement on next scheduled mandrel assembly or during the next preventive maintenance activity for EQ-P2-L3-RR01. Ensure one-time audit of three consecutive assemblies to confirm compliance and stability before returning to standard sampling frequency as defined in SOP-P2-L3-05.

## Approvals
Engineering approval required prior to issuance of revised MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1. Maintenance supervision and quality assurance sign-off required following the audit described in Implementation. Related documents to be updated accordingly: MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1, SOP-P2-L3-01, SOP-P2-L3-05.
